The combined on-load tap-changer consists of a diverter switch, a tap selector and a change-over selector. The diverter switch is located in the oil compartment. The motor drive unit drives the tap selector through the vertical driving shaft and the bevel gearbox. After lifting out the diverter switch insert, inspect the transition resistors, the main switching contacts and the terminal screen caps. The Buchholz relay is mounted on the transformer tank; the protective relay is mounted on the OLTC head cover.
